title: Hussain Bas Hussain
body:
shaheed e karbala hussain
mazloom e karbala hussain
ghareeb e nainawa hussain
hussain bas hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
shahadaton ke chaman mein gulon se leke kali tak
namood e hazrate aadam se leke sher e jali tak
azan e shakle nabi se namaz e binte ali tak
pukaar uthi hai karbala
hussain bas hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamon ki amaan pe kuch aisi chaayi hai ghata
haya labon pe hai tapish misaale arze karbala
kadakti dhoop mein koi hai rayt par jhuka hua
har ek zarra keh utha
hussain bas hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina kaleje se akbar ke khaynchli hussain ne
ragadti aediyan bete pe nigaah ki hussain ne
magar ye hausla allah ke uff na ki hussain ne
khaleel ne ye di sada
hussain bas hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
badhi bujhane ko asghar ki pyaas fauje ashkiyan
bajaye aab utaara galay mein teer e hurmala
malayeka ne ibadaat tark kar ke ye kaha
ay taaj daar e karbala
hussain bas hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
luta ke saare naujawan haye mutmain khada
kahin hai laashe baradar kahin hai janasheen pada
meinaan e sabr dekh kar khuda ki aayi ye sada
ay mere deen ki baqa
hussain bas hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabeeh e kibriya yahan wahan shaheed e karbala
wo janasheen nabi ka to ye hai faqr e ambiya
wo ibteda thi ishq ki ye hausle ki inteha
us inteha ne di sada
hussain bas hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke naam pe wo apna saara ghar luta gaya
na sirf ghar luta gaya wo apna sar kata gaya
hussain khud ujad ke deen ko is tarha basa gaya
pukari deen ki baqa
hussain bas hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina pe sheh ne jis ghadi tilawat e kalaam ki
mila jhula tha rob e bawafa o lehja e ali
tilawat e kalaam jab hussain ne tamaam ki
pukari mausuf e khuda
hussain bas hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazahir aaj bhi suno sada e zuljalaal hai
hussain be-misaal tha hussain be-misaal hai
ta hashr mohsin e hazeen yehi to la-zawaal hai
ye hai sada e kibriya
hussain bas hussain...
author: Mazahir
